summary: Parses a hexadecimal digit string into an int, reading characters from the end backwards. Each valid hex nibble (0-9, a-f, A-F) contributes v8 << (4 * nibble_index); any other character aborts with the partial result. Declared as __thiscall but does not reference the implicit this pointer, so it behaves as a free function.

operations.description: v3 = strlen(this): length of the input string.
if (v3 > 0): proceed only for non-empty strings; otherwise return v2 (0).
v6 = &this[v3 - 1]: walk pointer starting at the last character.
Classify v7 = *v6: if not a-f (v7 < 97 or v7 > 102) and not A-F (v7 < 65 or v7 > 70) and not 0-9 (v7 < 48 or v7 > 57), return the partial v2 immediately.
Nibble value mapping: digit '0'-'9' -> v7 - 48; 'A'-'F' -> v7 - 55; 'a'-'f' -> v7 - 87.
v9 = v8 << v5; v5 += 4 (shift nibble into its position); v2 += v9 (accumulate).
do-while loop: ++v4 and --v6 after each nibble, continuing while v4 < v3; processes every character of the string.
